raw.query: SELECT fc.run_id AS fc_run, fc_inf.achieved_p99_ms AS fc_p99, fc_inf.is_violation AS fc_violation, fc.provisioned_worker_seconds AS fc_worker_time, st.run_id AS static_run, st_inf.achieved_p99_ms AS static_p99, st_inf.is_violation AS static_violation, st.provisioned_worker_seconds AS static_worker_time, (st.provisioned_worker_seconds / fc.provisioned_worker_seconds - 1.0) * 100.0 AS pct_more_worker_time FROM provenance.v_pool_cost fc JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost st ON fc.experiment = st.experiment JOIN provenance.v_infraction fc_inf ON fc.run_id = fc_inf.run_id AND fc_inf.is_current JOIN provenance.v_infraction st_inf ON st.run_id = st_inf.run_id AND st_inf.is_current WHERE fc.run_id = 'g4:F6_enc_fc_rho15' AND st.run_id = 'g4:F6_enc_static_C5' AND fc.is_current AND st.is_current;
raw.observed: g4:F6_enc_fc_rho15 p99=1262.345ms (is_violation=true), worker_time=419391.2s; g4:F6_enc_static_C5 p99=904.739ms (is_violation=false), worker_time=431967.3s (+2.9987%)
raw.claimed: Policy fails on e13 onset fold (p99=1,262ms); static C=5 passes for 3% more worker-time.
raw.evidence: The forecast policy (g4:F6_enc_fc_rho15) misses the encoder bound with p99 1262.345 ms (rounds to 1,262 ms), while static C=5 (g4:F6_enc_static_C5) passes with p99 904.739 ms using 2.9987% (3.0%) more worker-seconds.
